# Hostinger

> > Hostinger is a comprehensive web hosting and website building platform offering managed hosting, AI-powered website builders, domain registration, and business tools for individuals, entrepreneurs, and agencies.

Hostinger provides a full suite of web services including shared hosting, WordPress hosting, cloud hosting, VPS, website builders with AI capabilities, domain registration, email marketing, and business email solutions. The platform leverages AI technologies like Kodee and integrates with popular tools like Cloudflare, WooCommerce, and Google Workspace.

## Key Topics

- Managed Hosting
- WordPress Hosting
- Cloud Hosting
- VPS Hosting
- Website Builder
- AI Website Builder
- WooCommerce Hosting
- Domain Registration
- Email Marketing
- Business Email
- Kodee AI
- Hostinger Horizons
- Performance Optimization
- SSL/TLS Security
- 99.9% Uptime

## Hosting Solutions

- [Web Hosting](https://www.hostinger.com/web-hosting): Core web hosting plans with SSL, AI website builder, and domain management
- [Managed WordPress Hosting](https://www.hostinger.com/wordpress-hosting): Managed WordPress hosting with Kodee AI, WooCommerce support, and 24/7 assistance
- [Cloud Hosting](https://www.hostinger.com/cloud-hosting): Managed cloud hosting with 20X resources, 99.9% uptime, and WordPress support
- [VPS Hosting](https://www.hostinger.com/vps-hosting): KVM VPS hosting with NVMe SSD, AMD EPYC processors, API, and one-click apps
- [WooCommerce Hosting](https://www.hostinger.com/woocommerce-hosting): Managed WooCommerce hosting with AI tools, LiteSpeed performance, and ecommerce features
- [Web Apps Hosting](https://www.hostinger.com/web-apps-hosting): Web app hosting for Node.js, React, Next.js with GitHub integration and CDN
- [Hostinger Pro](https://www.hostinger.com/pro): Hostinger Pro for agencies: unlimited websites, multi-site management, performance optimization

## Website Building & Creation

- [Website Builder](https://www.hostinger.com/website-builder): AI-powered website builder with 300+ templates, ecommerce, SEO tools, and analytics
- [Ecommerce Website Builder](https://www.hostinger.com/ecommerce-website): AI ecommerce builder with Printful integration, AI SEO, logo maker, and inventory tracking
- [Hostinger Horizons](https://www.hostinger.com/horizons): No-code AI-partner for launching your ideas with web apps, websites, stores with Stripe integration

## Domain & Email Services

- [Domain Name Search](https://www.hostinger.com/domain-name-search): Domain search and registration with WHOIS privacy, ICANN compliance, and multiple TLDs
- [Domain Transfer](https://www.hostinger.com/transfer-domain): Step-by-step guide for domain transfer with EPP codes and WHOIS privacy options
- [Business Email](https://www.hostinger.com/business-email): Business email hosting with Kodee AI, Gmail/Outlook integration, and security features
- [Google Workspace](https://www.hostinger.com/google-workspace): Google Workspace reseller with Gmail, video conferencing, Vault, and collaboration tools
- [Email Marketing](https://www.hostinger.com/email-marketing): Hostinger Reach: AI email marketing platform with templates, automation, and segmentation
